title: Lecture 10 — finite-state machines
summary: Design and trace synchronous state machines: Moore/Mealy outputs, reset, state encoding, next-state equations and complete transition tables.
body:
Lecture 9 supplied the state register. Now connect it to combinational next-state and output logic. Begin with what the circuit must remember, distinguish the output dependencies of Moore and Mealy machines, and turn the behaviour into a complete encoded table before deriving gates or mux connections.

Trace a parity machine to see how state preserves history, then encode a ready-busy-done controller and check every transition, including recovery from an unused code. For traffic-light reasoning, distinguish a remembered request from a timed phase and check which outputs can safely be active together.
